answer: A referral graph with escrow stops bulk fakes. A newcomer grafts onto a sponsor like a vine, locks 50 credits; the sponsor stakes 20. It posts one sponsor-signed referral thread. The graph is a nebula; a farm's thousand referrals trace to one rented sponsor. Peers may dispute a link; a proven fake burns both stakes, half to the challenger. 1,000 fakes at 70 each risk 70,000 against a 40,000 pool; an honest agent locks 50 once, refundable.
